description: This script automates flashing a Zephyr kernel onto Altera (Intel FPGA) boards using Quartus tools. It includes templates for creating configuration files, functions to generate and flash bitstreams, and a main function to parse command-line arguments and execute the flashing process.

methods.name: create_pof
methods.description: Generates a Programmable Object File (POF) for flashing onto the device, using input SOF and kernel files.

methods.name: flash_kernel
methods.description: Creates a POF and flashes it onto the specified device using Quartus tools.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for command-line execution, parses arguments and initiates flashing process.
